bestBet.title: Enquiry assistant for villa bookings
bestBet.whyItFits: Your site lists 12 villas and you said answering enquiries takes most of your week.

moneyAngle.detail: About 10 hours a week of WhatsApp replies handled automatically.

smallerIdeas.title: Multilingual villa descriptions
smallerIdeas.whyItFits: Your listings are English-only but Ibiza guests come from Germany, Spain and Italy.

moneyAngle.detail: More direct bookings from non-English visitors.

smallerIdeas.title: Lead qualification on the contact form
smallerIdeas.whyItFits: You mentioned many enquiries ask about dates that are already booked.

moneyAngle.detail: Hot leads answered first instead of lost in the queue.
